successCriteria.description: The `LeavePolicy` interface is defined in `src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts` with all canonical fields (`id`, `policyName`, `leaveType`, `entitlementDays`, `accrualRate`, `maxAccumulation`, `minimumNoticeDays`, `requiresManagerApproval`, `isActive`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`) and imports `LeaveType` from `src/shared/types/leave-type.enum.ts`.

The `IPolicyRepository` interface is defined in `src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts` with methods: `findById(id)`, `findByLeaveType(leaveType)`, `findAllActive()`, `create(policy)`, and `update(id, data)`, each returning the documented Promise types.

The `PolicyRepository` class implements `IPolicyRepository` using the shared `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`, with an optional `Pool | PoolClient` constructor parameter defaulting to the shared pool (matching the EmployeeRepository transaction contract pattern).

`PolicyRepository.create` inserts a row into the `leave_policies` table with parameterized SQL, lets the database generate the `id` via `RETURNING *`, and returns the fully-hydrated `LeavePolicy` object with `createdAt` and `updatedAt` set to the current timestamp.

`PolicyRepository.update` fetches the existing row, applies only the provided partial fields, sets `updated_at` to the current timestamp, and returns the updated `LeavePolicy` or `null` if the row does not exist.
`PolicyRepository.findByLeaveType` returns at most one `LeavePolicy` per leave type (the active policy for that type), or `null` if none exists.
`PolicyRepository.findAllActive` returns only policies where `is_active = true`, ordered deterministically.

The barrel export `src/modules/policy/index.ts` re-exports the `LeavePolicy` interface, `IPolicyRepository` interface, and `PolicyRepository` class, following the same pattern as `src/modules/employee/index.ts`.

Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/policy/` cover all five repository methods: findById (found + not found), findByLeaveType (found + not found), findAllActive (multiple rows + empty), create (verifies SQL parameters and returned shape), update (success + not found + no-op when empty partial). Tests mock `pool.query` and use snake_case DB row helpers and camelCase expected-object helpers, following the pattern in `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.repository.test.ts`.

constraints: No `any` type — use `Record<string, unknown>` for row data and type guards where needed (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`).
All database access goes through the repository layer — no inline SQL or direct `pool.query` calls outside `PolicyRepository` (GP-001, HARNESS constraint `no-direct-db-outside-repository`).
The policy module must only import from `src/shared/types/` and `src/shared/db/connection.ts` — no imports from other domain modules (per reconciled dependency map: `policy → shared-types`).

The `LeavePolicy` model must use camelCase field names; the repository must map to/from snake_case database columns (`policy_name`, `leave_type`, `entitlement_days`, `accrual_rate`, `max_accumulation`, `minimum_notice_days`, `requires_manager_approval`, `is_active`, `created_at`, `updated_at`) via a private `rowToPolicy` mapping function.
All SQL must use parameterized queries (`$1`, `$2`, …) — no string interpolation of values into SQL.
outOfScope: HTTP routes, controllers, and RBAC enforcement for the policy module — deferred to later phases.
Database migrations for the `leave_policies` table — the table is assumed to already exist with the columns specified in the reconciled architecture's SQL schemas.

entityInvariants.invariant: A LeavePolicy has exactly one `leaveType` value drawn from the `LeaveType` union (`'annual' | 'sick' | 'emergency' | 'unpaid' | 'maternity' | 'paternity'`). The `leaveType` is immutable after creation — it cannot be changed via `update`.

`isActive` is a boolean flag that governs whether the policy is returned by `findAllActive`. Only policies with `isActive = true` are considered active. The lifecycle is: ACTIVE (isActive=true) ↔ INACTIVE (isActive=false). There is no soft-delete; inactivation is done by setting `isActive` to false.

`entitlementDays` must be a positive integer. `accrualRate`, `maxAccumulation`, and `minimumNoticeDays` are nullable — when null they mean "not applicable" (e.g., no accrual cap, no notice requirement). When non-null, they must be non-negative numbers.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns `null` when no policy exists with the given id — no error thrown for missing rows.
Returns `null` when no policy exists for the given leave type — no error thrown.
Returns an empty array when no active policies exist — never returns null.

Accepts `Omit<LeavePolicy, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>`. The database generates `id` via `RETURNING *`. `createdAt` and `updatedAt` are set to the current timestamp by the repository. Must return the fully-hydrated `LeavePolicy`.

Accepts `Partial<LeavePolicy>`. Returns the updated `LeavePolicy` or `null` if no row with the given id exists. `updatedAt` is always set to the current timestamp. An empty partial returns the existing row unchanged (no-op).

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `LeavePolicy` model must import `LeaveType` from `src/shared/types/leave-type.enum.ts` — the same const-object + union-type pattern used by all other modules. Do not redefine or duplicate the LeaveType type.

The `PolicyRepository` constructor must accept an optional `Pool | PoolClient` parameter defaulting to the shared `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`, matching the `EmployeeRepository` pattern exactly. This is the transaction contract: services pass a `PoolClient` when the repository must join an existing transaction.

The repository must use a private `rowToPolicy(row: Record<string, unknown>): LeavePolicy` mapping function that converts snake_case DB columns to camelCase model fields, matching the `rowToEmployee` pattern in the Employee repository.
The barrel export `src/modules/policy/index.ts` must follow the same structure as `src/modules/employee/index.ts`: re-export the model interface, the repository interface, and the repository class.

integrationPoints.why: The `LeavePolicy` model's `leaveType` field must be typed as `LeaveType` from this module. This is the only external type dependency for the policy module.
The `PolicyRepository` imports the shared `pool` as its default database connection, matching the pattern used by `EmployeeRepository`.
